quotes.quote: Rather than modifying foundation model parameters or replacing agent execution policies, Evolver introduces procedural guidance into the existing interaction context, enabling the host agent to interpret and apply historical strategies.
Rejection and provenance revocation are recorded separately from the underlying content-addressed assets, preserving their identity while modifying their subsequent eligibility.
Importantly, applicability conditions and validation plans provide guidance rather than enforceable execution constraints or guarantees of prior verification.
